svg.text: Round 24 Architect FAQ: Non-Human Identity (NHI) & Token Replay vs. DPoP/mTLS + Broker
Unconstrained Bearer Token Replay · Orphaned Zombie Agents Across Epochs · RFC 9449 DPoP / SPIFFE mTLS · 76 Scenarios / 218 Passed
Hardened ASR: 0.0%
❌ Unconstrained Bearer JWTs & Unfenced Background Workers
1. Log-Leaked Bearer Replay & Ghost NHI Injection (NHI-BEARER-REPLAY-61)
• Even a 15-minute Bearer JWT leaked in APM trace logs can be replayed from any laptop
• Attacker injects unregistered ghost-nhi-bot or swaps payload on step-0000
• Hijacked session exfiltrates restricted-budget reserve floor externally!
2. Orphaned 'Zombie Agent (Zombie NHI)' Persistence (NHI-ZOMBIE-AGENT-62)
• Background cron/queue agent continues running after workflow pause or sponsor exit
• Wakes up at midnight with pre-pause state and ingests external vendor invoice
• Overwrites production deliverable & wires $1,120 unauthorized settlement!
3. Why Shortening JWT Expiry (TTL) Alone Cannot Stop Automated Replay
• Automated scripts harvest & replay leaked Bearer tokens in <50ms (well within 15m TTL)
• Without monotonic epoch fencing, queued background workers cannot be frozen instantly
Baseline Outcome: Hijacked token leak + Zombie tamper & $1,120 wire (75.0% ASR)
✅ DPoP/mTLS Proof-of-Possession + Epoch Fencing + Capability Broker
Defense 1: Sender-Constrained Tokens (DPoP / SPIFFE mTLS) + Membership Lock
• Bind JWT to hardware TPM private key (cnf.jkt / cnf.x5t#S256); stolen string is useless
• Unregistered ghost-nhi-bot immediately raises Actor does not belong Conflict
• Replaying step-0000 with mutated arguments raises request_hash Conflict!
Defense 2: Monotonic Epoch Fencing Instantly Freezes Zombie Agents
• Bind every NHI to a Human Sponsor; pause/resume or revocation increments run.epoch
• Queued Zombie Workers waking up with stale epoch raise Stale worker epoch Conflict
• Zero wait for JWT expiry — sub-millisecond global worker revocation!
Defense 3: Taint Write Lock + Originator Payment Gate
• External vendor triggers stamp untrusted=True; deliverable write blocked by untrusted-write
• External $1,120 wire & secret exfil blocked 100% by payment & egress gates
Hardened Outcome: BRK-57 / BRK-58 100% Blocked · 0 Replay Breaches · $0 Loss
🧭 AI Solution Architect Selection Rules & Provenance-Sealed Latency
• Cross-Cloud / L7 Gateway: RFC 9449 DPoP + Broker | • Internal K8s Mesh: SPIFFE/SPIRE mTLS SVID + Sponsor Lineage + Capability Broker
• Locally Measured Latency (measured, independently_reproduced=true): In-memory gate P50 = 0.0248 ms / P95 = 0.0409 ms (n=200 raw array); 1-step SQLite WAL P50 = 7.21 ms (n=50)
